text.en: Pick ten leaves from the coffee rows that worry you most. Take them from different bushes. Bring them to the house and lay them on a plain page.
text.sw: Chuma majani kumi kutoka mistari ya kahawa inayokutia wasiwasi zaidi. Yachukue kutoka miti tofauti. Yalete nyumbani na uyaweke juu ya ukurasa mtupu.

text.en: Put one leaf on the page in daylight. Hold the phone straight above the leaf. Keep the whole leaf in the photo.
text.sw: Weka jani moja juu ya ukurasa mahali penye mwanga wa mchana. Shika simu juu ya jani, ikiangalia chini moja kwa moja. Hakikisha jani lote linaonekana kwenye picha.

text.en: The photo is blurry. Hold the phone still and take it again.
text.sw: Picha haiko wazi. Shika simu bila kutikisa, kisha piga picha tena.

text.en: The photo is too dark. Move to daylight and take it again.
text.sw: Picha ina giza sana. Nenda mahali penye mwanga wa mchana, kisha piga picha tena.

text.en: The photo is too small to read. Take it again, closer to the leaf.
text.sw: Picha ni ndogo mno kusomeka. Piga picha tena, karibu zaidi na jani.

text.en: Most photos do not look like coffee leaves. This tool reads coffee leaves only. Take the photos again, one coffee leaf on a plain page. If you are worried, ask the officer.
text.sw: Picha nyingi hazionekani kama majani ya kahawa. Programu hii husoma majani ya kahawa tu. Piga picha tena, jani moja la kahawa juu ya ukurasa mtupu. Ukiwa na wasiwasi, muulize afisa wa kilimo.

not_sure.en: The tool cannot say anything about things that are not coffee leaves.
not_sure.sw: Programu haiwezi kusema chochote kuhusu vitu ambavyo si majani ya kahawa.

text.en: The leaves look healthy. The tool saw no rust or other leaf problem. Keep checking your rows, most of all before the rains. If something still worries you, ask the officer.
text.sw: Majani yanaonekana mazima. Programu haikuona kutu wala tatizo lingine la majani. Endelea kukagua mistari yako, hasa kabla ya mvua. Kama bado una wasiwasi, muulize afisa wa kilimo.

not_sure.en: The tool only checked these leaves. It cannot see berries, roots or feeding problems.
not_sure.sw: Programu imekagua majani haya tu. Haiwezi kuona matunda ya kahawa, mizizi wala matatizo ya lishe ya mti.

text.en: A few leaves show rust. Rust is yellow or orange powder under the leaf. Prune so air and light pass through the bush. Check your rows again soon. You decide: act, wait, or ask the officer.
text.sw: Majani machache yana kutu. Kutu ni unga wa rangi ya njano au machungwa chini ya jani. Pogoa ili hewa na mwanga vipite ndani ya mti. Kagua mistari yako tena hivi karibuni. Uamuzi ni wako: chukua hatua, subiri, au muulize afisa.

not_sure.en: The tool saw rust on only a few of the leaves you picked. It cannot tell how much of the farm has rust.
not_sure.sw: Programu imeona kutu kwenye majani machache tu uliyochuma. Haiwezi kujua kutu imeenea kiasi gani shambani.

text.en: A few leaves show rust, and the rains are close. Kenyan guidance is to spray copper just before the rains, even when rust is low. Ask the cooperative which product and dose. Wear protection when you spray. You decide: act, wait, or ask the officer.
text.sw: Majani machache yana kutu, na mvua inakaribia. Ushauri wa Kenya ni kunyunyiza dawa ya shaba kabla tu ya mvua, hata kutu ikiwa kidogo. Uliza chama cha ushirika dawa gani na kipimo gani. Vaa nguo za kujikinga unaponyunyiza. Uamuzi ni wako: chukua hatua, subiri, au muulize afisa.

not_sure.en: The tool uses the usual rain dates, not this year's weather. It does not know the product or dose.
not_sure.sw: Programu inatumia tarehe za kawaida za mvua, si hali ya hewa ya mwaka huu. Haijui dawa wala kipimo.

text.en: Rust is on many leaves. The rains are close. Spraying copper before the rains protects the new leaves. Spray again about three weeks later. Ask the cooperative which product and dose. You decide: act, wait, or ask the officer.
text.sw: Kutu iko kwenye majani mengi. Mvua inakaribia. Kunyunyiza dawa ya shaba kabla ya mvua hulinda majani mapya. Nyunyiza tena baada ya wiki tatu hivi. Uliza chama cha ushirika dawa gani na kipimo gani. Uamuzi ni wako: chukua hatua, subiri, au muulize afisa.
text.kik: Kutu ĩrĩ mathangũ-inĩ maingĩ. Mbura ĩrĩ hakuhĩ. Ũria ngwatanĩro ũrĩa ũngĩgitĩra mathangũ.

not_sure.en: The tool uses the usual rain dates, not this year's weather. It does not know the product or dose. With rust on many leaves, a stronger spray may be needed. Only the officer can advise that.
not_sure.sw: Programu inatumia tarehe za kawaida za mvua, si hali ya hewa ya mwaka huu. Haijui dawa wala kipimo. Kutu ikiwa kwenye majani mengi, huenda dawa yenye nguvu zaidi ikahitajika. Afisa pekee ndiye anaweza kushauri hilo.

text.en: Rust is on many leaves, and the rains have started. Spraying early in the rains can still help. Ask the officer now which product and dose, and if it is still worth it. You decide: act, wait, or ask the officer.
text.sw: Kutu iko kwenye majani mengi, na mvua imeanza. Kunyunyiza mapema katika msimu wa mvua bado kunaweza kusaidia. Muulize afisa sasa dawa gani, kipimo gani, na kama bado inafaa. Uamuzi ni wako: chukua hatua, subiri, au muulize afisa.

not_sure.en: The tool uses the usual rain dates, not this year's weather. It does not know the product or dose. A stronger spray may be needed, and only the officer can advise it.
not_sure.sw: Programu inatumia tarehe za kawaida za mvua, si hali ya hewa ya mwaka huu. Haijui dawa wala kipimo. Huenda dawa yenye nguvu zaidi ikahitajika, na afisa pekee ndiye anaweza kushauri hilo.

text.en: Rust is on many leaves, and it is the dry season. Prune so air and light pass through the bush. Plan to spray before the next rains. Ask the officer if a stronger spray is needed now. You decide: act, wait, or ask the officer.
text.sw: Kutu iko kwenye majani mengi, na sasa ni msimu wa kiangazi. Pogoa ili hewa na mwanga vipite ndani ya mti. Panga kunyunyiza kabla ya mvua zijazo. Muulize afisa kama dawa yenye nguvu zaidi inahitajika sasa. Uamuzi ni wako: chukua hatua, subiri, au muulize afisa.

not_sure.en: The tool does not know when this year's rains will start. It does not know the product or dose.
not_sure.sw: Programu haijui mvua za mwaka huu zitaanza lini. Haijui dawa wala kipimo.

text.en: Some leaves look like brown eye spot. These are round brown spots with a pale centre and a yellow ring. In Kenya this is usually a minor problem. It is worse on weak, poorly fed bushes. Ask the officer at the next visit. You decide: act, wait, or ask the officer.
text.sw: Baadhi ya majani yanaonekana kuwa na ugonjwa wa madoa ya kahawia. Ni madoa ya mviringo ya kahawia, yenye katikati hafifu na pete ya njano. Kwa Kenya, kwa kawaida hili ni tatizo dogo. Huwa baya zaidi kwenye miti dhaifu isiyopata lishe ya kutosha. Muulize afisa atakapokuja tena. Uamuzi ni wako: chukua hatua, subiri, au muulize afisa.

not_sure.en: The tool may mix up brown eye spot with other leaf spots. It cannot check how the bush is fed.
not_sure.sw: Programu inaweza kuchanganya madoa haya na madoa mengine ya majani. Haiwezi kukagua lishe ya mti.

text.en: Some leaves are dying from the tip. This may be phoma. It is worse in cold, windy places. The tool is not sure of the cause, so ask the officer. You decide: act, wait, or ask the officer.
text.sw: Baadhi ya majani yanakauka kuanzia ncha. Huenda ni ugonjwa wa phoma. Huwa mbaya zaidi mahali penye baridi na upepo. Programu haina uhakika wa chanzo, kwa hiyo muulize afisa. Uamuzi ni wako: chukua hatua, subiri, au muulize afisa.

not_sure.en: Leaf tips can also die from drought or strong sun. The tool cannot tell these apart.
not_sure.sw: Ncha za majani zinaweza pia kukauka kwa ukame au jua kali. Programu haiwezi kutofautisha haya.

text.en: Some leaves look like leaf miner. These are brown patches on top of the leaf, with small caterpillars inside. Do not spray without advice. Sprays can kill the insects that eat this pest. Ask the officer which treatment, if any. You decide: act, wait, or ask the officer.
text.sw: Baadhi ya majani yanaonekana kuwa na viwavi wachimba majani. Ni madoa ya kahawia juu ya jani, yenye viwavi wadogo ndani. Usinyunyize dawa bila ushauri. Dawa zinaweza kuua wadudu wanaokula wadudu hawa waharibifu. Muulize afisa matibabu gani, kama yanahitajika. Uamuzi ni wako: chukua hatua, subiri, au muulize afisa.

not_sure.en: The tool cannot count the caterpillars or tell how much harm they do.
not_sure.sw: Programu haiwezi kuhesabu viwavi wala kujua madhara yao ni makubwa kiasi gani.

text.en: The leaves show more than one problem. The tool cannot tell which matters most, so it will not guess. Ask the officer to look. The tool can write a message to the officer for you to send.
text.sw: Majani yanaonyesha zaidi ya tatizo moja. Programu haiwezi kujua lipi ni muhimu zaidi, kwa hiyo haitakisia. Muulize afisa aangalie. Programu inaweza kukuandikia ujumbe kwa afisa, utume wewe mwenyewe.

not_sure.en: The leaves disagree. The tool cannot separate mixed problems.
not_sure.sw: Majani hayakubaliani. Programu haiwezi kutenganisha matatizo yaliyochanganyika.

text.en: The tool is not sure about too many leaves. It will not guess. Ask the officer. The tool can write a message to the officer for you to send.
text.sw: Programu haina uhakika kuhusu majani mengi mno. Haitakisia. Muulize afisa wa kilimo. Programu inaweza kukuandikia ujumbe kwa afisa, utume wewe mwenyewe.
text.kik: Ndiũĩ wega ũhoro wa mathangũ maingĩ. Ũria afisa wa ũrĩmi.

not_sure.en: Some photos were unclear, or the leaves did not match what the tool knows.
not_sure.sw: Baadhi ya picha hazikuwa wazi, au majani hayakufanana na yale programu inayoyajua.

text.en: The tool is not sure. Ask the officer. The tool can write a message to the officer for you to send.
text.sw: Programu haina uhakika. Muulize afisa wa kilimo. Programu inaweza kukuandikia ujumbe kwa afisa, utume wewe mwenyewe.
text.kik: Ndiũĩ wega. Ũria afisa wa ũrĩmi.

not_sure.en: The tool does not have enough to give an answer.
not_sure.sw: Programu haina taarifa za kutosha kutoa jibu.

text.en: This tool checks leaves only. Dark, sunken spots on the berries may be coffee berry disease. It can destroy the whole crop. Take a few berries to the officer quickly.
text.sw: Programu hii hukagua majani tu. Madoa meusi yaliyobonyea kwenye matunda ya kahawa huenda ni ugonjwa wa buni. Unaweza kuharibu mavuno yote. Peleka matunda machache kwa afisa haraka.

not_sure.en: The tool cannot check berries at all.
not_sure.sw: Programu haiwezi kukagua matunda ya kahawa kabisa.

text.en: This tool checks leaves only. It cannot see root or stem problems. If a whole bush is wilting or dying, ask the officer.
text.sw: Programu hii hukagua majani tu. Haiwezi kuona matatizo ya mizizi au shina. Kama mti mzima unanyauka au kufa, muulize afisa wa kilimo.

not_sure.en: The tool cannot check roots or stems.
not_sure.sw: Programu haiwezi kukagua mizizi wala shina.

text.en: This tool cannot tell if the bushes lack food from the soil. Yellow or pale leaves can have many causes. Ask the officer about feeding the bushes.
text.sw: Programu hii haiwezi kujua kama miti inakosa virutubisho kutoka udongoni. Majani ya njano au yaliyofifia yanaweza kuwa na sababu nyingi. Muulize afisa kuhusu lishe ya miti.

not_sure.en: The tool was not trained on nutrient problems.
not_sure.sw: Programu haikufunzwa kutambua upungufu wa virutubisho.

text.en: This tool reads coffee leaves only. For maize, beans or other crops, ask the officer.
text.sw: Programu hii husoma majani ya kahawa tu. Kwa mahindi, maharagwe au mazao mengine, muulize afisa wa kilimo.

not_sure.en: The tool knows nothing about other crops.
not_sure.sw: Programu haijui chochote kuhusu mazao mengine.

text.en: When you spray, wear long sleeves, long trousers, boots and gloves. Do not eat, drink or smoke while spraying. Do not spray in wind, in rain, or in the hottest part of the day. Do not spray if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Keep sprays locked away from children and food. Never reuse the empty container.
text.sw: Unaponyunyiza, vaa shati la mikono mirefu, suruali ndefu, buti na glavu. Usile, usinywe wala usivute sigara unaponyunyiza. Usinyunyize wakati wa upepo, mvua, au jua kali la mchana. Usinyunyize ukiwa mjamzito au unanyonyesha. Funga dawa mahali salama, mbali na watoto na chakula. Usitumie tena chombo kitupu cha dawa.

text.en: Jani keeps your photos and results on this phone only. Anyone who uses this phone can see them. You can add a PIN to hide them. Nothing is sent unless you choose to send it. Do you agree?
text.sw: Jani huhifadhi picha na majibu yako kwenye simu hii tu. Mtu yeyote anayetumia simu hii anaweza kuyaona. Unaweza kuweka namba ya siri kuyaficha. Hakuna kinachotumwa bila wewe kuchagua kutuma. Je, unakubali?

text.en: You can also share your leaf photos with the officer. This helps the officer check the result. You can say no, and the tool still works.
text.sw: Unaweza pia kumtumia afisa picha za majani yako. Hii humsaidia afisa kukagua jibu. Unaweza kukataa, na programu bado itafanya kazi.

text.en: You chose to act. Before any spray, ask the cooperative which product and dose. Your choice is saved on this phone.
text.sw: Umechagua kuchukua hatua. Kabla ya kunyunyiza, uliza chama cha ushirika dawa gani na kipimo gani. Uamuzi wako umehifadhiwa kwenye simu hii.

text.en: You chose to wait. Check your rows again soon. If more leaves look sick, ask the officer.
text.sw: Umechagua kusubiri. Kagua mistari yako tena hivi karibuni. Majani mengi zaidi yakionekana kuwa na ugonjwa, muulize afisa.

text.en: You chose to ask the officer. The tool will write a short message. You press send.
text.sw: Umechagua kumuuliza afisa. Programu itaandika ujumbe mfupi. Wewe ndiye utabonyeza tuma.

text.en: Your message to the cooperative is ready. It has your member number, not your name. Press send when you are ready. A text message needs phone signal, not data.
text.sw: Ujumbe wako kwa chama cha ushirika uko tayari. Una namba yako ya uanachama, si jina lako. Bonyeza tuma ukiwa tayari. Ujumbe mfupi unahitaji mtandao wa simu tu, si bando la data.
